main_text.l: 2. Ut Hyems non erat tollenda; sic
rem ipsam, erat tollendum. Sed orandum
fuit, ne fuga incideret in alterutrum: ra-
um isto tempore futurum; ac simul po-
puli Judaïci dispersionem ac fugam, post
cœlesti illo signo palàm finis imponeretur

page.notes: Catchword "ri," is printed at the foot right; the text runs on as "precari, ..." Page top has a horizontal rule and a Google digitiser mark at bottom right, not transcribed. Some words are set in faint type and may be imperfectly read, e.g. "Deus," and "sic".
